title: Upgrade Node runtime for Vite 7
description: npm run build succeeds, but Vite warns that Node.js 20.17.0 is below its supported floor of 20.19 or 22.12. Upgrade the local runtime so build and dev server runs are on a supported Node version.
closeReason: Pinned supported Node metadata, added scripts/with-supported-node.mjs, routed Vite dev/build/preview and merged test execution through the supported Node wrapper. Final quality gate uses Node 22.13.1 for Vite.

title: Add real tests and style linting
description: The harness now exposes npm run quality, but npm run test is a placeholder and npm run lint is currently a TypeScript static check. Add a real test suite and dedicated style linting so Overstory builders and reviewers have stronger objective gates.
closeReason: Replaced placeholder test/lint scripts with Node test coverage, dependency-free style linting, updated CLAUDE command docs, and final quality gate coverage.

title: Establish Google Maps-first architecture policy
description:
## Why
VeloRail should stay centered on Google Maps APIs while adding LA-specific mixed-mode transit planning features.

## Outcome
A repo-level architecture policy exists and future agents know when custom geospatial logic is allowed.

## Scope
- In scope: implement the described capability in the existing VeloRail architecture.
- Out of scope: unrelated rewrites, alternate map providers, and speculative framework changes.

## Requirements
- Document Google Maps-first principles in AGENTS.md or docs/architecture.
- List currently used Google Maps APIs/SDK features after inspecting the repo.
- Define explicit exceptions for custom overlay data, GTFS parsing, freight-corridor datasets, and simulation logic.
- Do not overwrite existing Overstory/Mulch/Canopy setup.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Architecture policy committed without deleting existing setup.
- [ ] Policy states Google Maps remains the default rendering/routing integration surface.
- [ ] Policy requires source/provenance for non-Google custom transit overlays.
- [ ] Existing tests/build still pass or failures are documented.

## Google Maps Integration
Use Google Maps Platform wherever feasible. Custom data may be rendered through Google Maps overlays when Google does not expose the needed future/freight/visionary geometries.

## Mulch Memory Requirements
After completing this issue, record:
- Google Maps-first policy
- recognized existing repo tooling
- allowed exceptions for custom logic

## Canopy Planning Trigger
If implementation changes shared data models, map-layer contracts, routing assumptions, or UI architecture, create/update a Canopy plan before coding.
closeReason: Added docs/architecture/google-maps-first-policy.md documenting Google Maps-first architecture, current Google APIs in use, custom-data exceptions, provenance requirements, and review checklist. Quality gate passed in worker with Vite Node warning documented.

title: Define transit proposal data model

title: Fix Overstory mail check readonly database failure
description:
## Why
Overstory agents repeatedly hit `Error: attempt to write a readonly database` when running `ov mail check --agent <agent-name>`, which is part of the standard startup instructions. Agents currently have to fall back to `ov mail list` or manual SQLite reads, which breaks the intended coordination flow and causes repeated orchestration friction.

## Outcome
`ov mail check --agent <agent-name>` works reliably for Overstory agents in this repo, or the repo/runtime startup path is changed so agents use a supported read-only-safe mail check command by default.

## Scope
- In scope: diagnose the Overstory mail DB permissions/runtime path, update repo Overstory config/hooks/runtime wrapper/docs as needed, and add a regression check where feasible.
- Out of scope: replacing Overstory, changing Seeds semantics, or asking individual task agents to keep working around the failure manually.

## Requirements
- Reproduce the failure from an Overstory worktree or equivalent sandboxed agent environment.
- Identify whether the cause is SQLite file permissions, runtime sandbox mounts, read-state writes, mail DB location, or the `ov mail check` implementation.
- Make the standard AGENTS/overlay startup instructions accurate for the fixed behavior.
- Preserve mail safety and avoid corrupting `.overstory/mail.db`.
- Ensure `worker_done` / `merge_ready` mail paths are considered separately if they have the same write-permission root cause.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `ov mail check --agent <agent-name>` no longer fails with readonly database in a new Overstory agent session, or startup uses an equivalent supported command that does not attempt blocked writes.
- [ ] The fix is documented in AGENTS.md or Overstory agent definitions where agents receive startup instructions.
- [ ] A focused regression check or manual verification note is added for the mail check path.
- [ ] Known remaining mail-send limitations, if any, are documented as separate follow-up work.

## Mulch Memory Requirements
After completing this issue, record:
- root cause of the readonly mail DB failure
- fixed startup/mail command path
- any remaining Overstory mail limitations
